paragraphs: R' Yonatan Ish Kabbura. See the entry R' Yonatan Ish HaBirah.[^1]

notes.text: Ish Kabbura and Ish HaBirah are distinct supplied designations. The second line completes the target. Kabbura’s vowels and interpretation, the provisional heading and original entry extent remain uncertain; no location is assigned. Both abbreviated titles remain R'.
